messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: eu1/model-service canary 1.2.4 -> 1.2.4-hotfix failing health checks (502 spike). logs: https://deploy.internal/5312346789 :rotating_light:

michael: seeing a small but growing 502 rate on embeddings path around 11:22 UTC. user impact reported.

sara: can we freeze the rollout and triage? @ops-oncall please approve expedited fix path.

ops-oncall: oncall here, ack. need owner + pm signoff for fasttrack promote. what are rollback options?

emily: quick triage: migration hook sometimes double-invalidates kvcache keys in 1.2.4 -> causes 5xx. reproduced locally.

pranav: patch ready: add idempotent guard and skip double-invalidate. tests local green. building hotfix artifact.

lina: pm signoff: this is low risk, no product changes, approve expedited canary pin to v1.2.4-hotfix. :white_check_mark:

michael: propose canary plan: 5% for 5m, 20% for 10m. rollback if 5xx > 0.5% above baseline or P95 +50ms.

ops-oncall: agree. auto-rollback to v1.2.3 on threshold. I'll monitor dashboards.

pranav: artifact: v1.2.4-hotfix-2026-03-21-a1b2. hash a1b2c3d. smoke tests passed.

emily: executing deploy: `/deploy eu1 model-service canary --tag v1.2.4-hotfix-2026-03-21-a1b2 --percent 5 --pin true`

deploy-bot: Deploy started by emily. Canary at 5% (2/40 instances). logs: https://deploy.internal/5312346789/logs

michael: smoke curl to /health OK. small sample embedding queries return expected vectors.

pranav: quick synthetic load: `seq 1 30 | xargs -n1 -P6 -I{} curl -s -X POST https://eu1.api/embeddings -d '{"text":"t{}"}'` -> 0/30 5xx.

sara: rolling to 20% if no objections.

ops-oncall: thumbs up. armed auto-rollback: if 5xx_rate > 0.5% for 2m, revert to v1.2.3.

emily: `/deploy eu1 model-service canary --percent 20 --timeout 600`

deploy-bot: Canary 20%. Monitoring: errors, latency, kvcache-hits.

michael: baseline error 0.02%, current 0.03%. latency P95 steady.

lina: release note draft: "Fix: k-v cache invalidation race during prefix migration causing intermittent 5xx on embeddings (EU). Patched in v1.2.4-hotfix."

pranav: changelog entry ready. will include rollback standby instructions.

ops-oncall: holding final promotion until 11:45 UTC, monitoring for 15m.

emily: all green at 20% for 10m. bumping to 50%.

deploy-bot: Canary at 50% -> continuing rollout. auto-rollback still active.

pranav: prepare promote: `/deploy eu1 model-service promote --from-tag v1.2.4-hotfix-2026-03-21-a1b2 --to-prod --notify true`

lina: approved. create postmortem stub and link to PR after deploy.

ops-oncall: monitoring window extended 15m post-promote.

michael: good work. recommend adding a migration-path unit test to preflight. assign to pranav.

pranav: will open PR for test and add to preflight checks.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete. v1.2.4-hotfix promoted to prod eu1. Rollback target v1.2.3 configured. full logs: https://deploy.internal/5312346789/final-logs

lina: marking release notes as ready and will push docs during change window. :memo:

michael: closing thread  expedited hotfix deployed, no rollback needed. thanks team! :tada:
